items.caption: Empty Tokyo elevated platform at night. Multi-source isolated lighting: cyan vending machine + warm tungsten fluorescents + soft pink ad-panel glow + distant neon haze. Vanishing-point wide composition.

Honeybee-pastoral opener — summer cumulonimbus over a wide field of grass, small figure in the right third. Mandatory film-stock cluster (Vision3 250D + halation + lifted blacks + magenta cast) carries the entire image.
Same Tokyo platform, different beat. Same register applied at a different time of day demonstrates the grade survives transitions.
Letterboxed 1.85:1 cinematic composition inside a 9:16 deliverable. The bars are diegetic — they sell the film-print fiction.
